sendRequestWithFalsyContextVars.description:
Whether or not this {@link UiSdlComponentDataSpec} should send requests even if context vars are not resolved
to a truthy value. Overrides {@link UiSdlConfig#ignoreRequestsWithFalsyContextVars}

dataTransforms.description:
List of data transform types, which will be applied after the data is
received but before saving it in the state.

Constraint: These types must extend {@link UiSdlDataTransform}.

tunnelConfiguration.description: When not empty, data and metadata will be retrieved from the specified tunnel.

actionId.description:
An ID for this partially applied action that will become a part of the data source id (UiSdlDataRedux)
that is created for this partially applied action (this is done in `UiSdlComponent`).
If left blank, the actionId will be the name of the `UiSdlComponent` field for the
`UiSdlComponentDataSpec` that generated the `UiSdlPartiallyAppliedActionInfo`.
You can utilize the `actionId`'s presence in the data source id to backtrace which data source id is
associated with which `PartiallyAppliedAction`. See {@link UiSdlForm#doDataMerge} as an example of backtracing.

partiallyAppliedAction.description: The partially applied action to execute

title:
Wraps a PartiallyAppliedAction and an actionId.
The actionId is determined by the component's data spec and there is no defined pattern.
name: UiSdlPartiallyAppliedActionInfo
